summary: Tested the new Educational Trips feature (backend + frontend) for SCMS. Wrote 12 pytest cases covering CRUD + role-based access; all 12 PASS. Frontend: school admin can navigate to /school/trips, create, edit a trip via modal; teacher and parent see read-only views at /teacher/trips and /parent/trips with no add/edit/delete buttons; parent can tap a card and see the details modal with itinerary + tel: link. UI delete handler uses window.confirm() and works manually but flaked once in Playwright (page.once dialog handler race) - backend delete is fully verified.

issues: Date inputs use native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn-style calendar component - consistent with rest of app, not blocking

critical_code_review_comments: routes/trips.py: GET /api/trips/{trip_id} does not handle platform_admin with no school_id (would crash on tenant_db(None)) - minor since not in feature scope but worth a guard.
routes/trips.py: list_trips for platform_admin without school_id aggregates across all schools synchronously - acceptable for now but consider pagination.
TripsPage.jsx uses window.confirm for destructive delete - consider replacing with a proper confirmation modal for consistency/UX.
Unused imports in TripsPage.jsx and TripsViewPage.jsx: Path icon imported but never used in TripsPage; ArrowSquareOut/Path used in TripsViewPage are fine.
trips.py notification block silently swallows errors with broad except - already logged, acceptable since spec says notifications are best-effort.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (admin CRUD, teacher view, parent view + details modal all verified; delete-from-UI Playwright dialog assertion was flaky but functionality works)

seed_data_creation: Test trips created and deleted within pytest fixtures (TEST_ prefix); one UI test trip 'UI_TEST_Trip Heritage Walk' may remain in the demo school - safe to leave or clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trips feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_trips.py - run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_trips.py -v`. All role-based permissions enforced correctly (school_admin only for write; admin/teacher/parent/accounts/platform_admin can read tenant-scoped). _id properly excluded from responses. Frontend sidebar nav-school-trips / nav-teacher-trips / nav-parent-trips work; TripsPage uses data-testid add-trip-btn, submit-trip-btn, edit-trip-{id}, del-trip-{id}, trip-card-{id}. Parent details modal data-testid='trip-details-{id}' with tel: link data-testid='trip-call-{id}'.
